pages.title: Long-Horned Bison
pages.text: The long-horned bison ($(o)Bison latifrons$()) is an extinct bison that lived in North America during the Pleistocene, dying out before the end of the last ice age.$(br2)It was the largest bison ever to have lived, considerably bigger than the modern American bison.$(br2)Its horns were enormous, with tip-to-tip spans that could exceed two metres. It is thought to have lived in small groups in open woodland.
